Fix markdown table rendering issue with inline styles/links

## Type of changes

## Description

The table data elements were not interacting well with inline styles (in the rich sense) and the table data element would have its content overridden every time we found another excerpt of text with a different style.
The fix was to do something similar to what `TextElement` does in its method `on_text`, which is to append the new content instead of replacing it.

This fixes #3115.

It was creating a new `Text` object with `justify=self.justify`.
When we use `self.content = Text(justify=self.justify)`, any text appended to it will inherit that justification unless specified otherwise.

Wait, let's verify `rich.text.Text.append` behavior regarding justification.
Actually, `Text`'s justification is a property of the `Text` object itself, not the individual segments.
So `Text(justify=self.justify).append("foo")` will result in a `Text` object with `justify=self.justify`.

So the plan is:
